hypothesis: Same-venue complete sets and ordered sports totals/spreads may occasionally offer positive executable minimum-payout bundles after doubled fees, displayed-depth limits and non-atomic orphan stress.

universe.selection: deterministic round-robin by structure family, then nearest end time, fewest legs and candidate hash

certified_relations.binary_complement: the two outcome tokens of one binary condition
certified_relations.complete_mutually_exclusive_set: Gamma negRisk event only when every active market is a literal YES/NO predicate
certified_relations.sports_total_ladder: same event, statistic/period scope and normalized rule template; Over(high) implies Over(low)
certified_relations.sports_spread_ladder: same event, participant, statistic/period scope and normalized rule template; covering a lower handicap implies covering a higher handicap
certified_relations.crypto_nested_threshold: typed currency/crypto-price predicates with matching direction
certified_relations.disjoint_ranges: typed price ranges with non-overlapping bounds

execution.qualified_policy: A positive economic candidate remains unqualified while multi-leg submission is non-atomic.

evaluation.promotion: No live path. Passing permits a separate reviewed paper execution study only.
evaluation.null_outcome: No executable bundle or approximately zero edge is an accepted result.
